facts.text: Rogue, eat something. You'll be fine. Probably. The Professor makes better soup than he makes plans.
facts.why: Logan never says this and it is set in quote marks. A real Logan line to Rogue is 'My name's Logan.'

facts.text: Bobby keeps it cold. No fridge needed.
facts.why: Bobby is Iceman, so a cold drink is plausible, but the sources do not show him chilling a drink in a scene.
facts.fix: Bobby is Iceman. Cold on demand.
